limitations: No real user/developer project issued and no daily DB migration; existing UI still uses the legacy local profile. New authentication requires a separately prepared M008 DB and explicit v1 startup.

No new React email login screen (C11), actual file upload/criteria/business API persistence (C09/C10), external Vite/reverse-proxy or browser E2E (C12), worker (C13), restore/import (C14) or operational release (C15).
Authorization helpers are verified at service/DB boundary; actual future upload/download/review routes must call them inside their final transactions.

Production cookie attributes tested in HTTPS ASGI, not a real browser/TLS proxy. Real live test is loopback HTTP development. A misconfigured exposed development proxy cannot be made safe by trusting loopback alone.
Rate limiter is per-process bounded memory and resets on restart; documented single-worker launch and config checks are required. Cross-process service gate/storage capability remains C09.
Fault injection tests DB error behavior without stopping the daily DB/container. Unknown COMMIT acknowledgement reconciliation is inherited from UoW but not a new real network-loss test.
No public registration, email ownership verification, password reset email, MFA or SSO. CLI account creation prints allowed public email/UUID; secrets are never accepted in argv.
Argon2 timing is one macOS arm64 development measurement, not a production SLA or all-platform durability/performance proof.
